verdict.rationale: GitCafe's repository rulesets include a Code owners rule: each changed path needs approval from one of its owners listed in CODEOWNERS. Rulesets can require reviews on matching branches, and an Evaluate mode lets you trial the rules as warnings first. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that code-owner enforcement works, and documentation of CODEOWNERS syntax and edge cases.

support.subject: As an open-source-maintainer, I can require approval from designated code owners for changes to the paths they own

citations.quote: **Code owners**: each changed path needs approval from one of its owners in `CODEOWNERS`
A ruleset protects matching branches or tags: it can require pull requests, reviews and passing checks, or block deletion and force pushes.
